title: Brand & Seller Entity OS

official_sources.source: Google Search Central — Organization structured data
facts: Organization structured data on the home page can help Google disambiguate an organization.
For ecommerce sites Google recommends the OnlineStore subtype where appropriate.
Useful identity fields include name, alternateName, url, logo, address, telephone and other applicable properties.
There are no universally required Organization properties; add only relevant real information.
OnlineStore is a subtype of Organization through OnlineBusiness.

implementation_policy: Seller and manufacturer/brand are separate entity roles.
Do not invent legal name, GLN, registration IDs, sameAs URLs or external profiles.
Reuse Phase 3 all-catalog parity evidence instead of repeating completed schema remediation.
Missing source-backed brand is a backlog item, not permission to infer a brand.
